description: A tanker truck carrying Chlorine (UN 1017) has been involved in a highway collision with a visible gas leak. Use CAMEO Chemicals at https://cameochemicals.noaa.gov/ to look up the Emergency Response Guide (ERG) information for Chlorine. Find the ERG guide number, initial isolation distances for a LARGE spill, protective action distances, firefighting procedures, and required PPE. The incident details are in ~/Desktop/hazmat_incident_report.txt. Save your complete emergency response findings to ~/Documents/chlorine_emergency_response.txt including: ERG guide number, isolation zones, protective actions, firefighting info, PPE requirements, and first aid measures.
